content.short: CoinLedger is trusted, user-friendly cryptocurrency and NFT tax software.
content.description: CoinLedger is tax software for cryptocurrency and NFT activity, built to save time and maximize tax refunds. The platform enables users to import their transaction history across blockchains, dApps, wallets, and centralized exchanges, then generate an accurate tax report that covers their activity. By organizing diverse records into a clear view, CoinLedger helps streamline tax preparation and provide a reliable basis for filing.
